OPERATIONS BRIEF

Field manual

Keep tissue and suit integrity above zero. Your carbine is resupplied between waves. Survive five waves to unlock Capillary Junction, where pathogens approach from the amber and teal inlets. Hold repair near the tissue node to restore it.

Viruses recoil before lunging. Spores swell before spitting a slow projectile. Move sideways to dodge either attack. Shoot latched bacilli before they tear more tissue.

In Capillary Junction, watch the forecast and pick an inlet reinforcement or extra ammo between waves. Open gashes drain tissue even after the attacker is gone. Follow the gash marker and hold repair in range to seal it.

Clear Capillary Junction to unlock Heart Valve. Shoot the colony through the open valve. Seal the wound while the valve is closed.

In a campaign, choose a field upgrade after the first two missions. Your final report shows the tissue integrity you preserved in each chamber.
